'''''Loropetalum chinense''''', commonly known as '''loropetalum''',<ref name="Floridata">[http://www.floridata.com/ref/l/loro_chi.cfm "Floridata Plant Profile: #201 Loropetalum chinense"] at Floridata.com Retrieved 20 March 2019.</ref> '''Chinese fringe flower''' and '''strap flower''' is a shrub or small tree in the witch-hazel family, [[Hamamelidaceae]].<ref name="MPID">[http://libproject.hkbu.edu.hk/was40/detail?channelid=1288&lang=en&searchword=herb_id=D00308 "Loropetalum chinense"], (R.Br.) [[Daniel Oliver (botanist)|Oliv.]] at Medicinal Plant Images Database. Hong Kong Baptist University School of Chinese Medicine. Retrieved 20 March 2019. ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160403072817/http://libproject.hkbu.edu.hk/was40/detail?channelid=1288&lang=en&searchword=herb_id=D00308 archive])</ref>  

==Description==
They are [[evergreen]] with branches forming horizontal layers.<ref name="Floridata"/> The [[leaf|leaves]] are alternately arranged, ovate {{convert|1|to|2|in|cm|round=0.5|abbr=on|order=flip}}<!-- Note before editing: both units with these exact conversions are in the referenced source --> long by {{convert|1|in|cm|round=0.5|abbr=on|order=flip}} wide,<ref name="Floridata"/> and have a slightly abrasive feel.

==Cultivation and uses==
''Loropetalum chinense'' grows best in fertile, slightly acidic soil in full sun for deepest foliage colour and is hardy down to -15 degrees Celsius (5 degrees Fahrenheit). It is a popular [[ornamental plant]], grown for its prolific clusters of flowers and (in the case of the pink flowering variety) deeply coloured foliage that may contain various green, copper, purple and red tones. The leaves, flowers and roots of ''L. chinense'' ({{zh|c=檵木|p=jìmù}}) are all used in [[traditional Chinese medicine]].<ref name="MPID"/>

==Cultivars==
Two forms of ''L. chinense'' exist; a white- (to pale-yellow-) flowering green-leafed variety and a pink-flowering variety with leaves varying from bronze-red when new to olive-green or burgundy when mature, depending on selection and growing conditions.
